_meta.description: Master district/operator registry for the RECA yearbook-registry project. One entry per district that operates (or historically operated) schools in schools_master.json, plus districts discovered through Track C consolidation research.
conventions: successor_district_id: 'none' = still operating / no successor; 'unknown' = unresolved
predecessor_districts lists districts that merged INTO this district (and were dissolved by it)
types: public | parish_system | private_operator | county_special | state_agency | higher_ed
_meta.records_office_added: Track C addendum (Q4) 2026-10-14: records_office blocks added to all 70 entries. confidence=confirmed means the office/custodian was verified on the organization's public site; probable means custody is derived from successor_district_id under Missouri DESE guidance (closed-school records go to the district now serving the area) or from operator policy (e.g. open archdiocesan schools hold their own records; closed ones go to the Archdiocesan Archives). Parish schools are covered by DIST-401: closed parish/archdiocesan school records are held by the Archdiocese of St. Louis Archives (20 Archbishop May Dr), NOT the parish. The chain endpoint for a dissolved district is its successor's office — mirrored here.
